Contribution accepted for publication in Computers & Graphics

The article "XDoG: An eXtended difference-of-Gaussians compendium including advanced image stylization" by Holger Winnemöller, Jan Eric Kyprianidis, and Sven C. Olsen has been accepted for publication in a future issue of Computers & Graphics.
